```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Observed species richness

{{< include ObservedSpeciesRichness.Rmd >}}

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
OSR_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/OSR_ts.rds')


OSR_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/OSR_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(OSR_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(OSR_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +   # gesmoothte lijn per groep
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +             # ruwe data in dezelfde kleur
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Observed species richness",
       colour = "",
       title = "Observed species richness in Flanders based on raw GBIF data")+
  theme_minimal() 


```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Total Occurrences

{{< include TotalOccurrences.Rmd >}}

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
TO_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/TO_ts.rds')


TO_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/TO_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(TO_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(TO_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +

  # groeps-trend
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, alpha= 0.15) +

  # ruwe punten
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total occurences",
    colour = "",
    fill = "",
    title = "Total occurrences in Flanders based on raw GBIF data")+


  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )+
  theme_minimal() 
```
:::
